newsitem.title: USA: Disney to launch DisneyQuest next year.
newsitem.headline: Disney to launch DisneyQuest next year.

text.p: Walt Disney Co said Wednesday that DisneyQuest, its new interactive family entertainment concept, will be launched at a 100,000 square foot facility in Orlando, Florida in the summer of 1998.
Another site will be launched in Chicago in the summer of 1999 and future sites will open in other major domestic and international destinations.
DisneyQuest uses engaging interactive technologies to create an entertainment adventure for guests of all ages.
